description: City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov) is an open data portal listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. citydata.mesaaz.gov is the open data portal of City of Mesa for Mesa, Arizona. The infrastructure search read 55 of its datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water or digital network, asset or facility are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (permits, budgets, crime, health, planning, culture and similar) are ... Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. 55 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 10 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
